dataset: MedSafe_AI_Synthetic_400 test split (60 fictional generated prescriptions)
model: Tesseract --psm 6 with autocontrast grayscale and label normalization

latency.scope: Local Tesseract OCR + parsing, not full hosted GPU application

limitations: Standalone research reimplementation of the Tesseract baseline and conservative field/synthetic flag extraction; full application integration not verified in this local experiment
All thresholds are fictional and all labels generated, not independently clinician-adjudicated
Precision and recall calculated only on covered cases; abstentions are never scored as correct negatives
Cannot claim thesis clinical targets or real checkpoint inference from this development data
